name: view_stack_banners_same_tick
description: Waves that clear on one tick share one banner (M8, design 2.7 and 5.7): wave 2 called at once in wave 1 walks with it, every creep of both held at the Welling until both have set out, then every one sent to the Holdfast together, so stage 7 clears wave 1 and wave 2 back to back. The banner says both, their bonuses summed and the lives both waves' creeps took ('Waves 1–2 cleared · 28 lives lost · +22 gold'), not only the younger's with none lost; the gold went up by both bonuses, and the window opens.

steps.assert: Game.waves_on_road() == PackedInt32Array([1, 2]) and Game.spawns_left() == 0 and Game.lives == 200
steps.msg: both waves have set out, every creep held on the road

steps.assert: sent > 10 and Game.wave == 2 and Game.gold - gold_before == 22
steps.msg: both cleared on one tick, each paying its own bonus (10 and 12)

steps.assert: scene.leaks_in(1).get('lives', 0) > 0 and scene.leaks_in(2).get('lives', 0) > 0 and 200 - Game.lives == scene.leaks_in(1)['lives'] + scene.leaks_in(2)['lives']
steps.msg: every creep of both waves got through

steps.assert: node('BannerTitle').text == 'Waves 1–2 cleared · %d lives lost · +22 gold' % (200 - Game.lives)
steps.msg: one banner says both waves, both bonuses and the lives both took
